$description: PointSav design system — primitive token layer. Numeric scales (10/20/.../100 for color; 1..13 for spacing; 1..6 for duration) follow an industry-standard stepped-progression convention, so designers recognise the structure regardless of which system they arrive from. Color family names, hex values, spacing values, motion curves, and type scale are PointSav-original. Semantic overrides per tenant brand live in themes/<brand>.json.

surface.$description: Dark-mode chromatic-navy surface -- low chroma (0.04-0.05), hue 250/255. Warmer than pure neutral, cooler than blue.

brand-accent.$description: Per-tenant accent pattern -- one CSS custom property set via a `[data-instance]` attribute selector on the document root, applicable to every MediaKit engine (app-mediakit-knowledge, -marketing, -distributions). Only PointSav's own reference value lives here; each adopting tenant's value lives in that tenant's own media-assets repo (e.g. woodfine-media-assets/token-global-color.yaml's woodfine-editorial-accent-{projects,corporate}), layered on top via the same `[data-instance="<tenant>"] { --brand-accent: <value> }` mechanism.
